title: Restriction under coordinate reindexing
statement: Let $m,n$ be nonnegative integers, let $e$ be a bijection from the coordinates in $[m]$ to those in $[n]$, let $f$ be a function from the $m$-dimensional sign cube to $\{\pm1\}$, and let $\rho$ assign a restriction state to each coordinate in $[n]$. For every binary input $x$ on $[n]$, restricting the reindexed function according to $\rho$ equals evaluating the restriction of $f$ whose coordinate states are $\rho(e(i))$ at the input whose $i$th coordinate is $x(e(i))$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the $m$-dimensional sign cube
Equality holds pointwise for every binary input on $[n]$
